# Composer (`composer`)

Message input for chat and assistants: grows to six lines, action slots, mode chip, suggestions.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createComposer` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/composer.d.ts`): `.mh-composer`: a message input for chat and assistant apps. A text area that grows from one line up to `maxRows`, `__leading` and `__trailing` slots for buttons, an optional `__mode` chip inside the `__field`, an optional `__suggestions` row above it, and a `__notice` with the reason while disabled. The field shows the focus ring while the text area has keyboard focus.

```ts
export function createComposer(options: ComposerOptions): ComposerHandle;

export interface ComposerOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the text area (default "Message"). */
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  name?: string;
  /** Grows with its text up to this many lines, then scrolls (default 6). */
  maxRows?: number;
  enterSends?: ComposerEnterSends;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Shown above the field while disabled ("Not connected"). */
  disabledReason?: string;
  /** Shows a retry button next to the disabled reason. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  retryLabel?: string;
  /** Before the text: an attach button. */
  leading?: Child | Child[];
  /** After the text: send, microphone, voice (see `createComposerAction`). */
  trailing?: Child | Child[];
  mode?: ComposerMode | null;
  /** Quick replies in a horizontally scrolling row above the field. */
  suggestions?: readonly string[];
  /** Accessible name of the suggestions row (default "Suggestions"). */
  suggestionsLabel?: string;
  onSuggestion?: (text: string) => void;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  /**
   * Called with the text when Enter sends (see `enterSends`) or `submit()` is called, if it has any non-blank text
   * and the composer isn't disabled. The composer doesn't clear itself: call `setValue('')` once the message is
   * accepted.
   */
  onSubmit?: (value: string) => void;
}

export interface ComposerHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setPlaceholder(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Disables the composer, with an optional reason line (and the retry button, if `onRetry` was given). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean, reason?: string): void;
  setMode(mode: ComposerMode | null | undefined): void;
  setSuggestions(suggestions: readonly string[] | undefined): void;
  /** Sends the current text as Enter would. */
  submit(): void;
  focus(): void;
  /** Re-measures the height (call after the element is shown, if it was hidden when the value was set). */
  resize(): void;
}
```

`createComposerAction` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/composer.d.ts`): An icon button sized and toned for a composer slot.

```ts
export function createComposerAction(kind: ComposerActionKind, options: ComposerActionOptions = {}): IconButtonHandle;

export interface ComposerActionOptions {
  /** Accessible name; defaults per kind ("Send", "Dictate", ...). */
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createComposer, createComposerAction } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const sent = document.createElement('ol');

const composer = createComposer({
  placeholder: 'Ask about your home',
  leading: createComposerAction('attach').el,
  trailing: createComposerAction('send', { onClick: () => composer.submit() }).el,
  suggestions: ['Turn off all lights', 'Is the back door locked?', 'Warmer in the kitchen'],
  onSuggestion: (text) => {
    composer.setValue(text);
    composer.focus();
  },
  onSubmit: (text) => {
    sent.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('li'), { textContent: text }));
    composer.setValue('');
    composer.focus();
  },
});

document.body.append(sent, composer.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Composer, ComposerAction } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ComposerExample() {
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const send = (value: string) => {
    if (!value.trim()) return;
    setSent((messages) => [...messages, value]);
    setText('');
  };
  return (
    <>
      <ol>
        {sent.map((message, i) => (
          <li key={i}>{message}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      <Composer
        placeholder="Ask about your home"
        value={text}
        onInput={(value) => setText(value)}
        onSubmit={send}
        suggestions={['Turn off all lights', 'Is the back door locked?', 'Warmer in the kitchen']}
        onSuggestion={setText}
        leading={<ComposerAction kind="attach" />}
        trailing={<ComposerAction kind="send" onClick={() => send(text)} />}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
